mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in the CPIAUCSL exceeds +2%, the S&P 500 forward 60-day return is expected to be positive due to anticipated inflation normalization and reduced risk aversion.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL monthly change > +2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in monthly PAYEMS above the prior month's value by at least 5% is associated with stronger labor market conditions, which predicts a positive S&P 500 forward 20-day return as investor sentiment improves.
failure_condition: In 20-day window following PAYEMS > +5% monthly, SPX 20-day forward return is negative and statistically significant (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of HOUST rises by more than 10% from its prior 3-month average, it indicates accelerating industrial demand, which drives a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: 3-month MA of HOUST > previous 3-month MA by >10%
failure_condition: Over 5-day horizon, forward return is negative and the 3-month HOUST growth is not above 10% in any observation.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO of at least 8% suggests weakening manufacturing supply capacity, which tends to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly < INDPRO previous month by >=8%
failure_condition: In 20-day window following INDPRO decline >=8%, forward return is not significantly negative (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS falls by more than 1% over the next 3 months, the S&P 500 is expected to deliver a positive 60-day forward return as lower policy rates reduce discounting of future cash flows.
failure_condition: Over 60 days after FEDFUNDS decline > -1%, 20-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both UNRATE and PAYEMS by at least 0.5 percentage points suggests improved labor market conditions and reduced recession risk, predicting a positive 20-day forward return.
regime_hint: improving labor market and wage growth
failure_condition: 20-day forward return is negative despite both UNRATE and PAYEMS rising by >=0.5% monthly in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS falls by more than 15% in two consecutive months, it signals excess supply in financial markets, which is associated with a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Over 60 days after RSAFS decline >15%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly > +1.5%), the S&P 500 shows a negative 5-day forward return as investors anticipate higher real interest rates and demand for safe assets rises.
failure_condition: Over 5 days when CPIAUCSL monthly > +1.5%, forward return is not negative (p > 0.05).
